configs.label: Pd-Ag membrane R 0.90, permeate 1 bar
configs.nh3_basis: Pd-Ag permeate NH3 from experiment: 2.9 ppm (cechetto2023membrane p. 17 Table 10, Cechetto 2021, FTIR)
configs.model_status: Sieverts (n = 0.5) integrated along the module with H2 depletion; isothermal, isobaric; no NH3 inhibition modelled (not supported quantitatively by the library); membrane placed on the hot effluent (before the cooler), heat integration effect on FEHE/cooler not modelled
configs.n2_conditional_note: CONDITIONAL on ideal H2/N2 selectivity >= 12919 (N2 300 ppm); the base model assumes infinite selectivity. Sourced value (Phase 2): Cechetto et al. 2021 state ideal H2/N2 above 400,000 (double sealed) and above 500,000 (dead end) at 450 degC; the printed double-sealed N2 permeance (3.7e-11) gives only about 40,500, so the sourced range is 40,500 to 500,000. Caveats: ideal (single gas), new membrane, one group, 450 degC, trace NH3 only; mixed-gas and aged values not found
